aloofcardinal: Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina reported to R-R7 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Hugo Rock was grazed. Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina reached up to fix a sandbag at R-R7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Stefano of the Concord (@faccio.stefano). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina walked back up the communication trench to R-R7, slower than before, but on his own feet. Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh was grazed. The men at R-R7 heard Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Lucien Paulohwa of the Concord (@_paulohwa). Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina was hit at R-R7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Lucien Paulohwa of the Concord (@_paulohwa).
The papers connected Otto "Spark" Aloofcardina to Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina. The men took longer to learn Otto "Spark" Aloofcardina's own habits, but they made the effort.
coleharrison1210: Valentin Coleharrison found a place in S-C12 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Valentin Coleharrison wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home found Valentin Coleharrison before the night shift. Valentin Coleharrison folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin Coleharrison and Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. A letter from home found Valentin Coleharrison before the night shift. Valentin Coleharrison folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Valentin Coleharrison is number 700. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin Coleharrison looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Valentin Coleharrison across the shin at S-C12. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Casimir Lilsaint of the Hegemony (@carlos_lilsaint_).
kennethm05: Cyril Kennethm came up on Day 11 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached N-F13 with the rations. Cyril Kennethm ate while listening to the revised orders.
A parcel came for Cyril Kennethm that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
lezu_hans: On Day 6, Jakub Hans arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Hans stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Jakub Hans repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S9 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Jakub Hans's bunk. He has named it Captain.
Captain the rat now waits for Jakub Hans at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Captain ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Jakub Hans followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Captain his life.

Jakub Hans had just lit a cigarette at R-S9 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Quentin Lebronmygoat of the Hegemony (@lebronmygoat25). Blackwater Canal is lost. Jakub Hans heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

The medic cut the last bandage off Jakub Hans's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-S9 the same hour. Jakub Hans got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 371. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-S9 with the rations. Jakub Hans ate while listening to the revised orders.
Jakub Hans has not seen Captain for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
obreezyz1: Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz, a brewer from Oakmere, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz fought Zeno Mollard in a trench no wider than a door. Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz came home with Zeno Mollard's cap badge. (@bapt.mollard) After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz helped stack spare sandbags at T-F8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A note came over the wire at the Ossuary Wood, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Zanetaylor.' Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz sang louder. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz had just lit a cigarette at T-F8 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Neumann of the Hegemony (@schutze.neumann_).
swan.72041943: "You're late," said the corporal when Ulrich "Bones" Swan arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Ulrich "Bones" Swan shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Ulrich "Bones" Swan lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. Ulrich "Bones" Swan walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Ulrich "Bones" Swan kept watch so that Teodor "Spark" Box could sleep. Then Spark kept watch so that Bones could. Neither slept.
tsepnidiss._6: Norbert Tsepnidiss, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Norbert Tsepnidiss read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Norbert Tsepnidiss tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Norbert Tsepnidiss got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 771. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Norbert Tsepnidiss helped stack spare sandbags at R-C4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Norbert Tsepnidiss tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Halden. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
vbui._: Wendel Vbui arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Wendel Vbui traded a child's drawing of a horse for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. Grey Mill is lost. Wendel Vbui heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The party came back from Calvary Farm by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Wendel Vbui.
wanter_cz: The old hands of R-F19 have been here since Day 1. Clement Wanter has been here since Day 3. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Dawn watch. Clement Wanter put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub Nistico, grazed.

Clement Wanter tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. Clement Wanter walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A bullet went through Clement Wanter's sleeve at R-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Wendel Yaboyslydude of the Concord (@yaboyslydude).
Clement Wanter's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Clement Wanter was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss was grazed.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F19 through the wire. Clement Wanter gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Clement Wanter during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Clement Wanter counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. The clerk counted the names twice. Clement Wanter is number 217 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Clement Wanter wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Clement Wanter fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Silas Wumpus was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. A bullet grazed Clement Wanter's ribs at R-F19. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Henrik Sleepyman of the Concord (@sleepyman_191).
xmrmememanx: Day 9. The corporal put Marek Xmrmememanx beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Marek Xmrmememanx kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A supply man offered Marek Xmrmememanx a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Marek Xmrmememanx watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Someone asked Marek Xmrmememanx to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
